extra_quotes: STM measurements were carried out at a temperature of 9 K, using an instrument from RHK (PanScan Freedom), with a base pressure of 5×10−11 Torr.
dI/dV maps and line spectra were measured with a tunneling current setpoint of 145pA; the tip height was stabilized on the topography at a sample bias of−0.5V during the acquisition of the maps.
To determine the electronic properties of the systems we used the same distance dependent tight-binding model as in Ref.52.
Wave packet dynamics (WPD) calculations followed the method of Ref.17.

The walls are curved and the width of the region varies from 40 to 70 nm, so the cavity has no single length and we do not resolve the discrete mode spectrum seen in resonators with parallel walls, such as terraces bounded by straight step edges on Ag(111)48 and on rhombohedral trilayer graphene49.
